record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Aaron<WH0175>, Thou and thy sons<WH01121> and thy father's<WH01> house<WH01004> with thee shall bear<WH05375><WTH8799> the iniquity<WH05771> of the sanctuary<WH04720>: and thou and thy sons<WH01121> with thee shall bear<WH05375><WTH8799> the iniquity<WH05771> of your priesthood<WH03550>.

And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Aaron<WH0175>, Behold, I also have given<WH05414><WTH8804> thee the charge<WH04931> of mine heave offerings<WH08641> of all the hallowed things<WH06944> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>; unto thee have I given<WH05414><WTH8804> them by reason of the anointing<WH04888>, and to thy sons<WH01121>, by an ordinance<WH02706> for ever<WH05769>.

<FI> And<Fi> whatsoever is first ripe<WH01061> in the land<WH0776>, which they shall bring<WH0935><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068>, shall be thine; every one that is clean<WH02889> in thine house<WH01004> shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>of<Fi> it.

But the firstling<WH01060> of a cow<WH07794>, or the firstling<WH01060> of a sheep<WH03775>, or the firstling<WH01060> of a goat<WH05795>, thou shalt not redeem<WH06299><WTH8799>; they <FI>are<Fi> holy<WH06944>: thou shalt sprinkle<WH02236><WTH8799> their blood<WH01818> upon the altar<WH04196>, and shalt burn<WH06999><WTH8686> their fat<WH02459> <FI>for<Fi> an offering made by fire<WH0801>, for a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381> unto the LORD<WH03068>.
And the flesh<WH01320> of them shall be thine, as the wave<WH08573> breast<WH02373> and as the right<WH03225> shoulder<WH07785> are thine.

All the heave offerings<WH08641> of the holy things<WH06944>, which the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> offer<WH07311><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068>, have I given<WH05414><WTH8804> thee, and thy sons<WH01121> and thy daughters<WH01323> with thee, by a statute<WH02706> for ever<WH05769>: it <FI>is<Fi> a covenant<WH01285> of salt<WH04417> for ever<WH05769> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> unto thee and to thy seed<WH02233> with thee.<CM>

And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Aaron<WH0175>, Thou shalt have no inheritance<WH05157><WTH8799> in their land<WH0776>, neither shalt thou have any part<WH02506> among<WH08432> them: I <FI>am<Fi> thy part<WH02506> and thine inheritance<WH05159> among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>.

And, behold, I have given<WH05414><WTH8804> the children<WH01121> of Levi<WH03878> all the tenth<WH04643> in Israel<WH03478> for an inheritance<WH05159>, for<WH02500> their service<WH05656> which they serve<WH05647><WTH8802>, <FI>even<Fi> the service<WH05656> of the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>.

Neither must the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> henceforth<WH05750> come nigh<WH07126><WTH8799> the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>, lest they bear<WH05375><WTH8800> sin<WH02399>, and die<WH04191><WTH8800>. <RF>and die: Heb. to die<Rf>

But the Levites<WH03881> shall do<WH05647><WTH8804> the service<WH05656> of the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>, and they shall bear<WH05375><WTH8799> their iniquity<WH05771>: <FI>it shall be<Fi> a statute<WH02708> for ever<WH05769> throughout your generations<WH01755>, that among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> they have<WH05157><WTH8799> no inheritance<WH05159>.

But the tithes<WH04643> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, which they offer<WH07311><WTH8686> <FI>as<Fi> an heave offering<WH08641> unto the LORD<WH03068>, I have given<WH05414><WTH8804> to the Levites<WH03881> to inherit<WH05159>: therefore I have said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, Among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> they shall have<WH05157><WTH8799> no inheritance<WH05159>.
And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Thus speak<WH01696><WTH8762> unto the Levites<WH03881>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, When ye take<WH03947><WTH8799> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> the tithes<WH04643> which I have given<WH05414><WTH8804> you from them for your inheritance<WH05159>, then ye shall offer<WH07311><WTH8689> up an heave offering<WH08641> of it for the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>even<Fi> a tenth<WH04643> <FI>part<Fi> of the tithe<WH04643>.

And <FI>this<Fi> your heave offering<WH08641> shall be reckoned<WH02803><WTH8738> unto you, as though <FI>it were<Fi> the corn<WH01715> of the threshingfloor<WH01637>, and as the fulness<WH04395> of the winepress<WH03342>.

Out of all your gifts<WH04979> ye shall offer<WH07311><WTH8686> every heave offering<WH08641> of the LORD<WH03068>, of all the best<WH02459> thereof, <FI>even<Fi> the hallowed part<WH04720> thereof out of it. <RF>best: Heb. fat<Rf>

Therefore thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, When ye have heaved<WH07311><WTH8687> the best<WH02459> thereof from it, then it shall be counted<WH02803><WTH8738> unto the Levites<WH03881> as the increase<WH08393> of the threshingfloor<WH01637>, and as the increase<WH08393> of the winepress<WH03342>. <RF>best: Heb. fat<Rf>

And ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804> it in every place<WH04725>, ye and your households<WH01004>: for it <FI>is<Fi> your reward<WH07939> for<WH02500> your service<WH05656> in the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>.

And ye shall bear<WH05375><WTH8799> no sin<WH02399> by reason of it, when ye have heaved<WH07311><WTH8687> from it the best<WH02459> of it: neither shall ye pollute<WH02490><WTH8762> the holy things<WH06944> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, lest ye die<WH04191><WTH8799>.<CM>
